source.note: Bedrock state definitions use the documented types and allowed values from the referenced Bedrock sources. Java-only state names are not copied into Bedrock schemas. Editor starting values follow the documented Bedrock default when available.

minecraft_placement_direction.title: Placement direction
minecraft_placement_direction.purpose: Adds one or more placement-facing states to a custom block. Values are set by the game when it is placed.
properties: blocks_to_corner_with: block descriptors used with corner_and_cardinal_direction
minecraft_placement_direction.requirements: Custom block trait. It is not automatically added to every vanilla block.

minecraft_placement_position.title: Placement position
minecraft_placement_position.purpose: Adds block-face and/or vertical-half states to a custom block. Values are set by the game when it is placed.
minecraft_placement_position.requirements: Custom block trait. It is not automatically added to every vanilla block.

states.label: Block face
states.description: The face on which the block was placed.

states.label: Vertical half
states.description: Which vertical half of the space the block occupies.

minecraft_connection.title: Connections
minecraft_connection.purpose: Adds four cardinal connection states that update when neighboring blocks change.
minecraft_connection.requirements: Bedrock 1.21.130+ and the Upcoming Creator Features experiment.

states.label: North connection
states.description: Whether a block is connected on the north face.

states.label: East connection
states.description: Whether a block is connected on the east face.

states.label: South connection
states.description: Whether a block is connected on the south face.

states.label: West connection
states.description: Whether a block is connected on the west face.

minecraft_multi_block.title: Multi-block parts
minecraft_multi_block.purpose: Adds the part index for a custom block made from multiple blocks that act as one structure.
properties: direction: up, down, north, south, east, or west
minecraft_multi_block.requirements: Bedrock 1.26.10+. Before 1.26.40, the Upcoming Creator Features experiment is required.

states.label: Part index
states.description: 0 is the starting part; 1–3 are subsequent parts.

minecraft_multi_block.compatibilityNote: Microsoft documents that this trait cannot be combined with other traits, except minecraft:placement_direction when it is used to set minecraft:cardinal_direction.
